summary: Wallet is the fintech core of WMT: 43 artboards turning a creator-only payout account into a full multi-currency bank account for every user at Fintava MFB, with Naira/Dollar/Crypto accounts, send to WAWU users and any Nigerian bank, card/USSD/FX top-ups, swaps, crypto receive/send, NQR scan-to-pay, a physical/virtual Verve card, transaction PIN, statements, receipts and a creator earnings move. Today's backend has exactly five wallet routes (get, history, banks, resolve-account, withdraw) on a Flutterwave payout subaccount, opened for creators only, balance in whole naira, history limited to WAWU-instructed earnings/withdrawals/reversals, and one manual KYC gate on withdraw; bills are card-funded checkouts paid from WAWU's float. Reusable as patterns: the provider-gateway interface, name-enquiry-before-send, pending-not-failed settlement, idempotent references, webhook settlement and reconcile sweep, withdrawalsEnabled/reason, and the Flutterwave Bills catalogue; everything Flutterwave-specific (PSA create/balance/fund/transfer clients, webhook guard, barterId/accountReference columns) must be replaced if Fintava is adopted. Missing outright: transaction PIN, beneficiaries, fees, WAWU-to-WAWU transfer, inbound deposit recording, receipts, statements, QR/NQR, USD, FX, crypto and the entire card stack; the web has only a creator /wallet and /earnings that differ from the canvas. The biggest risk is regulatory and contractual, not code: dollar accounts, crypto custody, card issuing, pay-from-wallet with WAWU-collected fees, and wallets for every user each collide with the current 'WAWU never custodies money, Naira only, Flutterwave PSA' rule, and every Fintava capability, fee, limit and FX rate on the boards is unverified. Most build items are XL because they are blocked on Fintava API docs and product-owner rulings rather than engineering effort.
